test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The teacher will / certainly help you / if you will / ask her.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In conditional sentences, the word **"if"** is followed by the **simple present tense, not "will".**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "if you ask her,"** ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence: *"The teacher will certainly help you if you ask her.__"***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "ask her," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "The teacher will,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "certainly help you,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
